## GODOT 4.x + GDSCRIPT MASTERY + CODE-DRIVEN ART & ANIMATION
### 30 DAYS | 2D ONLY

**Philosophy:** Every visual, animation, effect, and UI element is generated by code. No hand-drawn sprites. No texture files. You are the programmer AND the artist.

---

### PHASE 1: Core Godot + Code Art Foundations (Days 1–6)

```
── Day 1 — Scene Tree & Node System + Canvas Drawing Basics
    ├── Godot Core:
    │   ├── Scene Tree: parent-child hierarchy, transforms, global vs local
    │   ├── Node types: Node2D, Control, CanvasItem
    │   ├── Scenes as reusable components (.tscn)
    │   ├── Instancing: instantiate(), add_child(), queue_free()
    │   ├── Node paths: $NodeName, %UniqueName, get_node()
    │   └── SKIP: Custom node types, Editor plugins, GDExtension
    │
    ├── Code Art:
    │   ├── _draw() override: the heart of code art
    │   ├── draw_rect(), draw_circle(), draw_line(), draw_polygon()
    │   ├── draw_string() for text rendering
    │   ├── CanvasItem: modulate, self_modulate, z_index, z_as_relative
    │   ├── queue_redraw() when data changes
    │   └── SKIP: Complex vector math, bezier curves, draw_arc() advanced
    │
    └── Daily Project: "Hello Canvas" — Draw a grid of colored rectangles
        using nested for loops. Each rectangle has a random color from a
        predefined palette. Clicking a rectangle changes its color.

── Day 2 — GDScript Fundamentals + Generative Shapes
    ├── Godot Core:
    │   ├── Variables, functions, loops, conditionals
    │   ├── Static typing: var, :=, -> void, -> int, -> Array, -> Dictionary
    │   ├── @export (Inspector exposure) vs @onready (deferred init)
    │   ├── String formatting, arrays, dictionaries
    │   ├── Match statements (GDScript's switch)
    │   └── SKIP: GDScript bytecode internals, C# interop
    │
    ├── Code Art:
    │   ├── Procedural shapes: random circles, rectangles, polygons
    │   ├── Nested loops for patterns: grids, spirals, waves, concentric circles
    │   ├── Random seed control: randi(), randf(), randi_range() for reproducible art
    │   ├── Color palettes stored as const arrays of Color values
    │   ├── Color.hex(), Color.from_hsv(), Color.html()
    │   └── SKIP: Perlin noise (Day 5), complex fractals

    └── Daily Project: "Generative City" — Procedurally generate a skyline

── Day 3 — Signals & The Observer Pattern + Animated Code Art
    ├── Godot Core:

    │

    │   └── SKIP: Physics-based animation, spring systems

    └── Daily Project: "Pulse Field" — 20 circles that pulse (scale up/down)
```
